items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: like Horace Silvers worked there with me for a while

ctx.x: This was it! (laughter) And then I decided that Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday would be for the guys, you know, when they come in I'd announce their names and make 'em feel comfortable, no matter what style they played, and if there was new-comers comin' up, I'd announce their names and if he's young like Lou Donaldson and Horace Silvers (sic), like Horace Silvers worked there with me for a while and, you know, Monk and everybody, like Bird was there all the time and Bill Holiday, she would come in with…
Yeah, this particular thing, but there's a number of questions I still have about the Paradise. Who owned the place and who managed it and what was that all about?
